+class CommandAdmission:
+    """Latch unresolved original ownership before any subsequent command.
+
+    The original Commands implementation still owns spawn/wait/terminate/reap.
+    This adapter only closes admission; it never signals a group, clears an
+    original observation or resumes after a later read-only absence proof.
+    """
+    def __init__(self, original, error_formatter):
+        self.original, self.error = original, error_formatter
+        self.root, self.cwd = original.root, original.cwd
+        self.environment = original.environment
+        self.groups, self.absent_groups = original.groups, original.absent_groups
+        self.blocked = None
+        self.first_exception = None
+
+    def _latch(self, label, error=None):
+        unresolved = sorted(set(self.groups).difference(self.absent_groups))
+        if unresolved and self.blocked is None:
+            self.blocked = {"status": "CLOSED_UNRESOLVED_ORIGINAL_OWNED_GROUP", "label": label,
+                            "groupsAtClosure": unresolved, "at": time.time()}
+            if error is not None:
+                self.blocked["firstFailure"] = self.error(error)
+
+    @property
+    def is_open(self):
+        self._latch("before-next-operation")
+        return self.blocked is None
+
+    def run(self, argv, label, timeout=120, **kwargs):
+        require(self.is_open, "Original owned group is unresolved; subsequent command admission is closed")
+        try:
+            return self.original.run(argv, label, timeout, **kwargs)
+        except BaseException as error:
+            if self.first_exception is None:
+                self.first_exception = self.error(error)
+            self._latch(label, error)
+            raise
+        finally:
+            self._latch(label)
+
+    def present(self, group):
+        # Only the unchanged final observer uses this read-only operation.
+        return self.original.present(group)
+
+
+def retain_receipt(shared, path, value, phase):
+    """Keep the first failure in memory even when exclusive receipt IO fails."""
+    try:
+        shared.write(path, value)
+        return True
+    except BaseException as error:
+        observation = {"phase": phase, "path": str(path), **shared.error(error)}
+        value.setdefault("firstFailure", observation)
+        value.setdefault("receiptFailures", []).append(observation)
+        value["status"] = "FAIL"
+        return False

+    def unresolved_original(root):
+        """No process is spawned; this is an explicit portable custody fixture."""
+        class OriginalFixture:
+            def __init__(self):
+                self.root, self.cwd, self.environment = root, root, {}
+                self.groups, self.absent_groups, self.spawns, self.probes = [], set(), [], []
+
+            def run(self, argv, label, timeout, **kwargs):
+                self.spawns.append((argv, label))
+                self.groups.append(42)
+                raise RuntimeError("portable original owned group lacks absence proof")
+
+            def present(self, group):
+                self.probes.append(group)
+                return False
+        return OriginalFixture()
+
+    def test_unresolved_original_group_closes_every_later_spawn_even_after_final_absence(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="pinkha-core13-portable-group-") as temporary:
+            original = self.unresolved_original(Path(temporary).resolve())
+            commands = run.CommandAdmission(original, self.originals.shared.error)
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "lacks absence proof"):
+                commands.run(["portable-fixture-no-executable"], "first", 1)
+            self.assertFalse(commands.is_open)
+            for name in ("xcresult", "preserve", "shutdown", "next-suite"):
+                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "admission is closed"):
+                    commands.run(["portable-fixture-no-executable"], name, 1)
+            self.assertEqual(len(original.spawns), 1)
+            # Use the unchanged final original read-only observer. Its new
+            # positive absence cannot reopen admission or erase first failure.
+            observed = self.originals.host_functions.observe_owned_groups(commands)
+            self.assertEqual(observed["status"], "PASS")
+            self.assertEqual(original.probes, [42])
+            self.assertIn(42, original.absent_groups)
+            self.originals.host_functions.observe_owned_groups(commands)
+            self.assertEqual(original.probes, [42])
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "admission is closed"):
+                commands.run(["portable-fixture-no-executable"], "after-final-observation", 1)
+            self.assertEqual(len(original.spawns), 1)
+            self.assertEqual(commands.blocked["firstFailure"]["type"], "RuntimeError")

+cannot reopen execution or erase the earlier unresolved custody failure.
